CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_wage_difference(offered_wage TEXT, prevailing_wage TEXT, wage_unit enum_wage_unit_of_pay, pw_unit enum_pw_unit_of_pay) RETURNS NUMERIC AS $$
SELECT ROUND(CAST(
    (CASE wage_unit::text
        WHEN 'Hour' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(offered_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 2080
        WHEN 'Week' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(offered_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 52
        ELSE (REPLACE(REPLACE(offered_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 12
    END - 
    CASE pw_unit::text
        WHEN 'Hour' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 2080
        WHEN 'Week' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 52
        WHEN 'Month' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 12
        ELSE (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC
    END) / 
    NULLIF(CASE pw_unit::text
        WHEN 'Hour' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 2080
        WHEN 'Week' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 52
        WHEN 'Month' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC * 12
        ELSE (REPLACE(REPLACE(prevailing_wage, '$', ''), ',', ''))::NUMERIC
    END, 0) * 100
AS NUMERIC), 2);
$$ LANGUAGE sql;
